business_profile.tagline: Effortlessly book your next car wash with just few taps
business_profile.description: Splasheroo is a UK-based waterless car wash app offering convenient, eco-friendly car washes at your location.  Their fully equipped technicians provide premium wash experiences without using water.
audience: Individuals seeking convenient car wash services

faqs.question: How do I make a booking?
faqs.answer: Download the Splasheroo app, create an account, add vehicle details, select location, service, date/time, make payment, and wait for the technician.

faqs.question: How long will my wash take?
faqs.answer: Approximately 40-60 minutes, depending on vehicle size and service type.

faqs.question: Do I have to be present onsite while my wash is going on?
faqs.answer: Not for exterior washes; for interior cleaning, only vehicle access is needed.  App notifications provide updates.

faqs.question: Will your process damage my car?
faqs.answer: No, Splasheroo uses specially formulated nano-solutions and trained technicians with quality checks.

faqs.question: How much spaced do you need to clean my car?
faqs.answer: At least two feet of space on each side of the vehicle.

faqs.question: What is a waterless car wash?
faqs.answer: An environmentally friendly alternative using a specially formulated solution to clean the vehicle's surface without water.

faqs.question: How many bookings can I make?
faqs.answer: One car per booking; add additional vehicles to book multiple cars.
